finding: src/anomaly/attempts.py:29 The documented public run_attempts utility writes before enforcing whole-case no-symlink containment.
rationale: A valid-phase direct call reaches load_snapshot before any containment check, and load_snapshot creates durable paths through a symlinked root or .anomaly directory; the only later scan examines a copied workspace after owner execution, so no upstream guard prevents the documented public utility from writing outside the case and the high CWE-59 severity is honest.

evidence.output: run_attempts validates only that phase is known and immediately calls load_snapshot(root). load_snapshot immediately calls _ensure_durable_tree(root), which mkdirs root/.anomaly/receipts and attempts, writes state.json through a temporary file plus replace, and touches events.jsonl; none of these operations performs lstat or calls _scan_case_tree.

evidence.command: read src/anomaly/attempts.py:55-84; read src/anomaly/_attempt_workspace.py:10-23; read src/anomaly/case.py:257-299
evidence.output: After durable state and attempt-path writes, run_attempts calls create_workspace and execute, then calls _scan_case_tree(workspace), not _scan_case_tree(root). create_workspace uses shutil.copytree(root, workspace) without symlinks=True, so the later scan sees the copied target content rather than protecting the caller-supplied symlink path; _scan_case_tree itself would reject root/ancestor and descendant links if it had been called before the writes.

run_workflow is protected by resume_case before it calls run_attempts, but run_attempts has no equivalent guard. tests/test_pipeline_walk.py imports anomaly.attempts.run_attempts directly and calls it at lines 623 and 625, while the installed skill explicitly documents run_attempts as the durable attempt executor, confirming a separately reachable utility path rather than a dispatcher-only private helper.
